name: Insurance

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: Health insurance segment grows over 20%; strong quarter for life insurers
mofsl_2qfy27.read: General insurance health grew ~20% and motor over 10% YoY; ICICIGI regained motor momentum and STARHEAL and NIVABUPA improved claims ratios, while BGEN's GWP grew 10% with motor at 18%. Private life insurers delivered APE growth of 16%/13%/11%/7%/10%/8% (IPRULIFE/HDFCLIFE/CANHLIFE/SBILIFE/BLIFE/MAXLIFE) and VNB margin expansion of 100bp/40bp/170bp/130bp/460bp/150bp; LIC saw a sequential VNB margin dip on weak ULIP demand. MOFSL flags uncertainty over the final distribution reforms as the key risk for insurers and distributors.

unit_economics: Life: VNB = APE x VNB margin, EV = adjusted net worth + value of in-force, profit lags value because acquisition cost is expensed; General and health: profit = NEP x (1 - combined ratio) + investment income on the float, so each 1pp of combined ratio moves EPS far more at short-tail health insurers.

price_drivers.driver: Distribution reform: commission caps and expense-of-management limits
price_drivers.why: MOFSL calls uncertainty over final distribution reforms a key risk; the draft proposes a 15% (life) and 25% (general) EoM path, and credit-life commission at 2%.

price_drivers.driver: Individual APE growth and VNB margin
price_drivers.why: Life APE grew 7-16% in Q2FY27 with margin expansion of 40-460bp; VNB is what the market capitalises through appraisal value.

price_drivers.driver: Combined ratio: claims ratio in health and motor
price_drivers.why: Health grew ~20% with claims ratios improving at STARHEAL and NIVABUPA; weak underwriting at ICICIGI was offset by investment income, so profit is sensitive to claims pricing.
Product mix sets margin and LIC's margin dip came from weak ULIP demand; persistency feeds operating variance in EV.
Reference-rate changes move non-par VNB margins and EV; realised gains inflate general insurer PAT.

kpis.name: Individual APE growth
kpis.definition: Annualised premium equivalent on individual business (regular premium plus 10% of single premium), derived for the single quarter from cumulative disclosures.
kpis.formula: Individual APE (YoY) with quarter derived as cumulative minus prior cumulative
kpis.why_it_moves_price: APE is the volume leg of VNB; MOFSL reports 16%/13%/11%/7%/10%/8% for IPRULIFE/HDFCLIFE/CANHLIFE/SBILIFE/BLIFE/MAXLIFE, and growth below capacity shows up in margin not opex.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'APE' (cumulative: build single quarters); Motilal Oswal results tables in the report library; Life Council monthly data outside Airavat.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models (Motilal Oswal, Kotak IE) and APE growth guidance from transcripts (SBILIFE 14-15% APE growth, STARHEALTH fresh business growth over 18% on its metric); get_consensus_estimates gives PAT/EPS not APE.
kpis.traps: APE definitions differ (group term counted at 100% at SBI Life and HDFC Life); cumulative reporting; Q4 carries 32-34% of individual APE; LIC and SBI Life diverge from Council data.

kpis.name: VNB and VNB margin
kpis.definition: Value of new business and VNB over total APE, with the cost basis (actual vs long-run) and tax basis stated, and the rate effect separated from mix.
kpis.formula: VNB / total APE; rate-adjusted margin = margin - (change in reference rate x disclosed sensitivity)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: VNB drives EV growth and appraisal value; margins rose 40-460bp in Q2FY27 (BLIFE +460bp) while LIC's dipped, and SBILIFE aims for the upper end of its 26-28% band.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'VNB' and 'VNB margin'; EV report via list_library_documents (doc_type annual_report); Motilal Oswal results tables.
kpis.estimate_source: Management margin guidance from transcripts (SBILIFE 26-28% band); broker models (Motilal Oswal) for VNB; Bloomberg consensus covers PAT/EPS/BVPS, so VNB and EV come from broker models.
kpis.traps: Margin denominator (total vs individual APE); expense-overrun booked only at year end (ICICI Life); tax at 25% would cut VNB 10-15%; yield-curve gains non-repeatable.

kpis.name: Combined ratio (stated basis)
kpis.definition: Claims, commission and expenses as a share of premium, always labelled with its basis: n or 1/n, IGAAP or Ind AS, with or without discounting.
kpis.formula: Net claims / NEP + (net commission + opex) / NWP
kpis.why_it_moves_price: General insurers run near 100% so 1pp of combined ratio is 7-18% of EPS; MOFSL notes weak underwriting at ICICIGI offset by investment income, and claims-ratio improvement at STARHEAL and NIVABUPA drove their beats.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'combined ratio', 'loss ratio'; get_financials for premium and claims; Motilal Oswal results tables.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models (Motilal Oswal, Kotak IE) and management CoR guidance from transcripts; Bloomberg consensus gives PAT/EPS, so combined ratio comes from broker models.
kpis.traps: n vs 1/n basis, five different CoRs at Go Digit, upfront vs deferred acquisition cost, Ind AS in FY27 for SAHIs vs IGAAP elsewhere, crop and CAT swings, reserve releases in motor TP.

kpis.name: Expense of management vs proposed cap
kpis.definition: Commission plus operating expenses over premium on the regulatory basis, against the draft IRDAI cap path.
kpis.formula: (Commission + opex) / premium (life: total premium; general: GDPI)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: The gap to the cap sets the commission cut and volume risk; MOFSL says the final reforms are the key risk, and ICICIGI expects lower distribution cost to raise affordability and volumes.
kpis.history_source: Annual reports via list_library_documents (doc_type annual_report) for commission by line; get_financials for expenses and premium; get_investor_presentation for company EoM disclosures.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker regulatory-impact notes in the report library and management mitigation commentary from transcripts; no consensus field.
kpis.traps: Company EoM on regulatory basis vs GWP basis; PMFBY partially counted; group credit life and single-premium commission; bundled loan-linked sales.

kpis.name: 13-month and 61-month persistency
kpis.definition: Share of premiums renewing at 13 and 61 months, premium basis, by channel and product where disclosed.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Falling persistency produces negative operating variance and assumption changes in EV and, after the surrender rules, costs margin directly.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'persistency'; L-22 disclosures in annual reports via list_library_documents.
kpis.estimate_source: Management commentary from transcripts; broker models; no consensus field.
kpis.traps: Premium vs policy basis; one-month lags at some insurers; SBI Life dropped 61M from headline metrics.

kpis.name: Operating RoEV and EV
kpis.definition: Embedded value operating profit (unwind + VNB + operating variance) over opening EV; the basis for P/EV.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Justified P/EV = (RoEV - g)/(CoE - g); RoEV of 15-20% supports 2x+ EV while LIC near cost of equity trades near 0.4-0.8x.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'EV' and 'RoEV'; EV reports in annual reports via list_library_documents.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker EV and VNB models (Motilal Oswal); get_consensus_estimates for EPS/BVPS only, so EV is broker-sourced.
kpis.traps: IEV vs MCEV bases; economic variance and non-operating items outside EVOP; interim annualisation.

kpis.name: Health loss ratio: retail vs group
kpis.definition: Claims ratio on retail indemnity separated from group health, with fresh-vs-renewal mix and claim size and count.
kpis.formula: Net claims / NEP for retail and group separately
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Health grew ~20% and STARHEAL and NIVABUPA improved claims ratios; part of the improvement is price and group exit, so separating retail loss ratio shows whether it is durable.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'loss ratio' and 'retail health'; annual report segment data via list_library_documents.
kpis.estimate_source: Management guidance from transcripts and broker models; no consensus field for loss ratio.
kpis.traps: UPR methods differ (Niva); Ind AS vs IGAAP loss ratios; vintage effects as waiting periods end.

kpis.name: Motor loss ratio and prior-year reserve development
kpis.definition: Motor OD and TP loss ratios with favourable prior-year development as a share of NEP.
kpis.formula: Prior-year reserve release / NEP; TP loss ratio
kpis.why_it_moves_price: MOFSL notes motor growth over 10% with BGEN motor at 18%; releases on motor TP flatter profit, so a motor loss ratio fall without frequency improvement may reverse.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'motor' and 'loss ratio'; annual report triangles (ICICI Lombard) via list_library_documents.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models and transcripts; no consensus field.
kpis.traps: Court-award reserving, TP tariff freeze or cut risk, crop seasonality.

kpis.name: Realised gains share of PAT and solvency
kpis.definition: Realised capital gains as a share of PBT, with FVCA cushion and solvency ex sub-debt.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Gains can drive PAT beats that do not recur; solvency limits growth in non-par and protection.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (investment income); get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'solvency'.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates for PAT/EPS/BVPS; broker models for gains split.
kpis.traps: Gains disclosed late; sub-debt moves solvency 4-20pp in a quarter.

valuation_anchor: P/EV and appraisal value for life insurers (justified P/EV from operating RoEV); P/B against RoE or P/E on underlying earnings for general and standalone health insurers (Ind AS earnings for SAHIs).
watch_next_quarter: Watch the final IRDAI distribution reforms; STARHEAL's reinsurance GST benefit entering the base from Oct'26 and moderating reported growth in 3Q-4QFY27; SBILIFE's 14-15% APE growth and upper-end VNB margin; CANHSBC's APE under possible distribution reform; ICICIGI's NEP growth in 2HFY27.
